summary.text: Dragon Court is the name Dragon Spirit uses for the Immortal Gu House that has him.

claims.text: Inside Dragon Palace, a boy with horns and a tail tells Bai Ning Bing that a blessed land has a land spirit, a grotto-heaven has a heavenly spirit, and Dragon Court has him, Dragon Spirit. Bai Ning Bing knows the Immortal Gu House as Dragon Palace. Dragon Spirit says dragonman Gu Immortals created Dragon Court, but Duke Long did not allow it and changed its name to Dragon Palace. Duke Long does not know Dragon Spirit exists and has the false impression that he successfully refined Dragon Court.
Dragon Court’s power has not been displayed fully because it lacked a true master. Dragon Spirit calls it only a rank eight Immortal Gu House at that time.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Dragon Court is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile once used in combat, not a five-region map seat.

Wu Shuai snatched South Flower Island because he needed a secretive location to build an Immortal Gu House. After a hundred years, with fortuitous encounters, a stream of resources, and help from dragonman Gu Immortals, this rank seven Immortal Gu House is created. Wu Shuai says a few hundred more years might make it rank eight.

As the creator, he overrules other suggestions and names it Dragon Court. He laughs that it complements Heavenly Court. His father says that in the eyes of human Gu Immortals, Dragon Court is not a name that complements Heavenly Court. It is clearly a rebellious sign. Wu Shuai will not change the name.

A huge castle appears from nowhere. Wu Shuai goes inside and charges while manipulating this palace. The palace soars toward the sky, up into the clouds. Observers have never seen an Immortal Gu House like it. It is as if Song Tao Zi’s green heaven pine wave does not exist. The palace carves out a pathway, unaffected. This is not an ordinary rank seven Immortal Gu House. It can resist rank eight existences. After the kill, Dragon Court floats in the sky.

Wu Shuai uses Dragon Court against Song Tao Zi in a life-and-death battle announced to the world. Dragon Court approaches. Song Tao Zi refuses to kneel. Wu Shuai uses Dragon Court to charge over, and Song Tao Zi is crushed to death. Wu Shuai later tells Tai Qin that even with rank seven cultivation, he can use this house to fight rank eight. That is why Green Ant Ascetic and Calligraphy Pavilion Lady attended his banquet, and why Wind Cloud Manor has concerns about dealing with him. He intends to become rank eight and elevate Dragon Court to rank eight as well.

Wu Shuai accumulated for a hundred years and constructed the rank seven Immortal Gu House Dragon Court, then used it to kill Song Tao Zi and become renowned. After decades of intensified conflict between dragonmen and humans, Duke Long summons him, orders him to announce his crimes, step down as owner of South Flower Island, and change Dragon Court’s name to Dragon Palace. Wu Shuai is unwilling but still too weak against Duke Long and Heavenly Court. He follows the instructions reluctantly. He is still afraid to attempt the final tribulation even with Dragon Court.
